flags: CRITICAL: Explicitly prohibits GDPR compliance. Terms of Service Section 3.6 states customers 'will not (i) use any of the services provided hereunder to collect or otherwise process personal data subject to European data protection laws and regulations, including the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation'. This is a hard blocker for EU/international expansion and customers with EU data obligations.

No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other major security certifications despite serving 400k+ enterprise customers. While not necessarily a security weakness, this is unusual for enterprise SaaS platforms and may limit procurement eligibility for regulated industries.

Streams AI product (launched 2026) draws on aggregated platform/lead data for its AI features, but whether it trains AI models on customer data is not established in public documentation and there is no explicit opt-out or training-consent language. Treat AI training status as unknown and verify directly with vendor.
No formal Data Processing Agreement (DPA) mentioned in public documentation despite serving B2B customers. CCPA compliance requires DPA for California businesses.
Privacy policy only updated to address California (CCPA) regulations; limited compliance scope outside North America.
